title: tk --json command manifest and minimum version
description: SPEC §3.1 / §12 Phase 0 step 1. Publish the list of tk --json commands ticfac may call (reads: show/list/graph/ready/next/deps/status; controlled writes: claim, update, note, close/reopen, merge-file, merge-activity), each with a versioned JSON schema, and a machine-readable minimum tk version (e.g. tk version --json reporting a contract number). A command must fail closed when its requested contract is unavailable or incompatible. Document that a host that cannot run tk (Cloudflare Workflow) implements the same contract in its own language and proves it with the bundle.
